figures.name: Tinia

ability.name: Triple Thunderbolt
ability.description: Tinia has three thunderbolts; this ability uses the most powerful, dealing 8 damage and stunning.

figures.description: King of the Etruscan gods who wields three kinds of thunderbolts of increasing destructive power.

figures.name: Uni

ability.name: Royal Mantle
ability.description: Grant all female/goddess allies +3 to all stats; block one enemy attack completely.

figures.description: Queen of the Etruscan gods who later merged with Juno, protector of cities and divine authority.

figures.name: Menrva

ability.name: Augury Wisdom
ability.description: Look at all enemy abilities; choose one to permanently disable.

figures.description: Etruscan goddess of wisdom and war who later merged with the Roman Minerva, one of the supreme triad.

figures.name: Charun

ability.name: Hammer of Passing
ability.description: When any card is destroyed, deal 2 damage to the nearest enemy.

figures.description: Blue-skinned underworld demon with a hammer who guides and sometimes drags souls to the land of the dead.

figures.name: Vanth

ability.name: Winged Reckoning
ability.description: When any card dies, grant this card +1 to all stats permanently.

figures.description: Winged female demon who accompanies the dying and witnesses every death, merciful yet inevitable.

figures.name: Voltumna

ability.name: Fanum Votumna
ability.description: All Etruscan/earth allies gain +2 to all stats; enemy strategies are revealed.

figures.description: Supreme national god of the Etruscan league at whose sanctuary all twelve cities gathered in council.

figures.name: Nethuns

ability.name: Sacred Spring
ability.description: Restore 3 HP to all allies; water allies become immune to fire for 1 turn.

figures.description: God of wells and all water who later merged with the Roman Neptune, lord of the sacred springs.

figures.name: Fufluns

ability.name: Vine Surge
ability.description: Restore 3 HP to all allies; inflict ecstasy on one enemy for 1 turn.

figures.description: Etruscan god of wine and plant growth who presided over health and the joyful abundance of the harvest.

figures.name: Turms

ability.name: Fleet Sandals
ability.description: Move any ally or enemy to a new position; steal one stat boost from an enemy.

figures.description: Etruscan messenger god who guided souls and presided over commerce, later identified with Mercury.

figures.name: Aita

ability.name: Helm of the Dead
ability.description: Make this card invisible to enemies for 1 turn; deal 3 dark damage.

figures.description: Etruscan ruler of the underworld who wore a wolf-skin cap of invisibility, counterpart of Greek Hades.

figures.name: Phersipnai

ability.name: Queen's Decree
ability.description: Remove one enemy from the field for 1 turn; they return with -2 to all stats.

figures.description: Queen of the Etruscan underworld, counterpart of Persephone, who presides over the realm of the dead.

figures.name: Tuchulcha

ability.name: Serpent Lash
ability.description: Inflict three different debuffs simultaneously on one enemy.

figures.description: Terrifying underworld demon with a beak, donkey ears and serpents for hair who torments the dead.

figures.name: Laran

ability.name: Youth's Battle Cry
ability.description: Allies with power below 7 gain +3 power for 1 turn.

figures.description: Young Etruscan god of war depicted as a naked warrior youth, fierce patron of soldiers.

figures.name: Alpan

ability.name: Free Gift
ability.description: Remove one forced ability or charm effect from any ally.

figures.description: Etruscan goddess of love, grace and free will who appears in the underworld as a divine attendant.

figures.name: Usil

ability.name: Dawn Spear
ability.description: Deal 5 damage to dark-aligned enemies; grant +1 speed to all allies.

figures.description: Etruscan sun god depicted running across the sky with a solar disc, twin of the dawn.

figures.name: Lasa

ability.name: Mirror Truth
ability.description: Reflect one enemy ability back at them at half power.

figures.description: Winged female fate spirits who appear in mirrors and attend the dying, recording their deeds.

figures.name: Mania

ability.name: Ghost Mother
ability.description: Summon one ghost with 4/6/4/4/4 stats for 2 turns.

figures.description: Mother of the Lares, spirits of the household dead, whose name became a word for madness.

figures.name: Thalna

ability.name: Birth Right
ability.description: The next ally summoned enters with +3 to all stats.

figures.description: Etruscan goddess of birth and fate who appears at the moment of delivery to determine the child's destiny.

figures.name: Catha

ability.name: Torchbearer
ability.description: Illuminate the field: all hidden or invisible enemy cards are revealed.

figures.description: Etruscan sun deity who not only crosses the sky but descends through the underworld each night.

figures.name: Sethlans

ability.name: Artisan's Touch
ability.description: Choose one ally: their next special ability cannot be blocked or negated.

figures.description: Etruscan god of fire and the forge who later merged with Vulcan, patron of all skilled craftsmen.
